description: message_ix_models provides the public tools used to build and study the MESSAGEix-GLOBIOM family of energy-system models. IIASA publishes a Python package and documentation for retrieving upstream inputs, transforming parameters, creating scenarios, running variants and reporting results. The family includes a global base model and country or sector variants for buildings, transport, materials and water. Users provide compatible scenario data, technology assumptions and solver infrastructure; outputs are model scenarios and reported energy-system quantities for the selected region and planning years. Apache-2.0 source is public. A limitation stated in the documentation is that some related project material remains in a separate non-public message_data package; a public install does not guarantee reproduction of every IIASA study. The tools support cross-sector capacity and climate-policy simulations. The catalogue's model-messageix-framework is the general optimisation framework, while this package supplies the model-family workflows and inputs. No scenario data or solver was run.
